Welcome to Comoros — one of the least explored island countries in Africa, hidden in the Indian Ocean!
Our journey to Comoros started with unexpected flight changes, a long layover and plenty of confusion. Finally, we reached Moroni via Ethiopian Airlines and began exploring a country that very few Indian travellers visit.
In this first Comoros vlog, I share the visa-on-arrival experience, airport arrival, local transport, hotel stay, first impressions of Moroni, Indian food and my first interaction with an Indian living in Comoros.
